<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Page not found – Lycos</title>

  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet" integrity="sha384-QWTKZyjpPEjISv5WaRU9OFeRpok6YctnYmDr5pNlyT2bRjXh0JMhjY6hW+ALEwIH" crossorigin="anonymous">
  <style>
    :root {
      --lycos-accent: #0066cc;
      --lycos-accent-hover: #0052a3;
      --lycos-dark-bg: #181c1a;
      --lycos-dark-border: #353937;
      --lycos-dark-text: #e8e8e8;
      --lycos-dark-text-muted: #a0a8a4;
      --home-news-thumb: 200px;
      --home-surface-border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      --home-text-secondary: #5c6368;
      --home-hero-accent: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.12);
      --home-card-radius: 0.65rem;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      position: relative;
      background-color: #fff;
    }
     
    .lycos-footer-stack {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .boston-ground {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 100%;
      height: min(58vh, 620px);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
       
      background-color: #fff;
      background-image: url("/static/boston.png");
      background-position: center bottom;
       
      background-size: contain;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
    }
    .navbar-lycos {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a2e2c 0%, #181c1a 100%) !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lycos-dark-border);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }
    .navbar-lycos .navbar-brand,
    .navbar-lycos .nav-link { color: var(--lycos-dark-text) !important; }
    .navbar-lycos .nav-link:hover { color: #fff !important; }
    .navbar-lycos .nav-link.active { font-weight: 600; color: #7eb8f0 !important; }
    .navbar-lycos .navbar-toggler { border-color: var(--lycos-dark-border); }
    .navbar-lycos .navbar-toggler-icon { filter: invert(1); }
    .navbar-lycos .nav-severe-weather {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-width: 1.1rem;
      height: 1.1rem;
      margin-left: 0.2rem;
      padding: 0 0.2rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #dc2626;
      color: #fff !important;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
      vertical-align: 0.05em;
    }
    .nav-global-search .input-group {
      min-width: min(100%, 14rem);
      max-width: 20rem;
    }
    .nav-search-input {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
      border-color: var(--lycos-dark-border) !important;
      color: var(--lycos-dark-text) !important;
    }
    .nav-search-input::placeholder {
      color: var(--lycos-dark-text-muted);
    }
    .nav-search-input:focus {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
      border-color: var(--lycos-accent) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.25);
    }
    .footer-lycos {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, #2a2e2c 0%, #181c1a 100%) !important;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--lycos-dark-border);
      box-shadow: 0 -2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      color: var(--lycos-dark-text-muted);
    }
     
    main.main-shell {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      flex: 1 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      background: transparent;
      min-width: 0;
      padding-bottom: min(52vh, 580px);
    }
    main.main-shell > .container {
      background-color: #fff;
       
      background-image: linear-gradient(
        to bottom,
        #fff 0%,
        #fff calc(100% - 10rem),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) calc(100% - 5rem),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) 100%
      );
    }
.footer-lycos a { color: var(--lycos-dark-text-muted); text-decoration: none; }
.footer-lycos a:hover { color: var(--lycos-dark-text); }
.footer-lycos .footer-made { color: var(--lycos-dark-text); }
    .navbar-brand { font-weight: 700; }
    .navbar-brand img { height: 2rem; width: auto; display: block; }
    .home-logo { height: 3rem; width: auto; display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
     
    .home-hero-band {
      background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--home-hero-accent) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 42%, #f8f9fa 100%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--home-surface-border);
      width: 100%;
    }
     
    main.home-main {
      max-width: none;
      width: 100%;
      padding-top: 0;
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }
    .home-hero {
      padding: 1.25rem 0 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .home-hero { padding: 1.5rem 0 1.5rem; }
    }
    .home-hero-panel {
      max-width: 40rem;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .home-hero-kicker {
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--lycos-accent);
      margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
    }
    .home-hero-tagline {
      max-width: 26rem;
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.3vw, 1.1875rem);
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--home-text-secondary);
    }
    .home-hero-quick {
      gap: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
    }
    .home-hero-quick a {
      color: var(--lycos-accent);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .home-hero-quick a:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--lycos-accent-hover); }
    .home-search-form { max-width: 36rem; }
    .home-search-wrap { width: 100%; }
    .home-search-input-group {
      border-radius: 999px !important;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--home-surface-border);
      transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .home-search-input-group:focus-within {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.2);
      border-color: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.3);
    }
    .home-search-icon {
      color: #8b939c;
      padding-left: 1rem;
      padding-right: 0.25rem;
    }
    .home-search-input {
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }
    .home-search-input-group .btn {
      border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0 !important;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tiles {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 1rem 1.35rem;
      max-width: 40rem;
      margin: 1.15rem auto 0;
      padding: 0 0.5rem;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      width: 5.4625rem;  
      text-decoration: none;
      color: #1a1d21;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile:hover {
      color: #1a1d21;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile:hover .home-advertiser-tile-logo {
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid #0d6efd;
      outline-offset: 3px;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile-logo {
      width: 4.3125rem;  
      height: 4.3125rem;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.08);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile-logo img {
      width: 70%;
      height: 70%;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
    }
    .home-advertiser-tile-name {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.25;
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .home-suggest-menu {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      top: calc(100% + 0.4rem);
      z-index: 30;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      border-radius: 1rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.12);
      overflow: hidden;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .home-suggest-forbes {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      background: #f3eee6;
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .home-suggest-forbes:hover,
    .home-suggest-forbes.is-active {
      background: #ebe4d8;
      color: inherit;
    }
    .home-suggest-forbes-mark {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      min-width: 3.1rem;
      height: 1.85rem;
      padding: 0 0.4rem;
      border-radius: 0.15rem;
      background: #000;
      color: #fff;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-top: 0.15rem;
    }
    .home-suggest-forbes-body { min-width: 0; }
    .home-suggest-forbes-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      line-height: 1.3;
      margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    }
    .home-suggest-forbes-meta {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: #5c6570;
      line-height: 1.3;
      margin: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .home-suggest-forbes-meta strong {
      color: #1a1d21;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .home-suggest-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      color: #1a1d21;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
    }
    .home-suggest-item:hover,
    .home-suggest-item.is-active {
      background: #f5f7f9;
      color: #1a1d21;
    }
    .home-suggest-item-icon {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      color: #9aa3ad;
      display: inline-flex;
    }
    .home-suggest-item-text {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .home-suggest-item-text .suggest-rest {
      font-weight: 700;
    }
     
    .home-main-columns {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding-top: 0;
      padding-left: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1rem);
      padding-right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1rem);
    }
    @media (min-width: 992px) {
      .home-main-columns {
        margin-top: 1.25rem;
      }
    }
    .home-intro-line {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--home-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 36rem;
    }
    .home-section-title {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.07em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #5c636a;
      margin: 0 0 1.125rem 0;
    }
    .home-main-news { min-width: 0; }
    .home-news { width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
    .home-news-tile {
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) !important;
      transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
    }
    .home-news-tile-link:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--lycos-accent);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: 0.375rem;
    }
    .home-news-tile-link:hover .home-news-tile {
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) !important;
      border-color: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.22) !important;
    }
    .home-news-tile-inner { min-height: 100%; }
    .home-news-tile-media {
      width: var(--home-news-thumb);
      flex: 0 0 var(--home-news-thumb);
      padding: 0.75rem 0 0.75rem 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      align-self: center;
    }
    .home-news-tile-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 112px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      display: block;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    }
    .home-news-tile-body { flex: 1 1 auto; }
    .home-news-cat { color: var(--lycos-accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .home-news-source { color: var(--home-text-secondary); }
    .home-news-title { line-height: 1.35; }
    .home-news-tile-link:hover .home-news-title { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--lycos-accent) !important; }
    .home-sidebar {
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .home-sidebar-card {
      border-radius: var(--home-card-radius) !important;
      border: 1px solid var(--home-surface-border) !important;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }
    .home-sidebar-card:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) !important;
      border-color: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.12) !important;
    }
    .home-sidebar-card .home-section-title {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .home-travel-lead {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--home-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .home-travel-more {
      margin-top: 0.85rem;
    }
    .home-travel-more a {
      color: var(--lycos-accent);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .home-travel-more a:hover {
      color: var(--lycos-accent-hover);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    @media (max-width: 991.98px) {
      .home-sidebar {
        margin-top: 2rem;
        padding-top: 2rem;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      }
    }
    @media (min-width: 1200px) {
      .home-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 1rem; align-self: flex-start; }
    }
    .home-weather { width: 100%; }
    .home-weather-mount {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
    }
    .home-weather-mount .home-weather-inner {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      border: 1px solid var(--home-surface-border);
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .home-weather-surface-link:hover .home-weather-inner {
      border-color: rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.35);
    }
    .home-weather-surface-link:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid #0d6efd;
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }
    .home-weather-icon { object-fit: contain; }
    .home-weather-attribution {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;
    }
    .home-weather-accu-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      line-height: 0;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .home-weather-accu-logo {
      width: 100px;
      height: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: left center;
    }
    .home-sidebar-extra:not([hidden]) { display: block; }
    .home-news-desc {
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--home-text-secondary);
    }
    @media (max-width: 575.98px) {
      .home-news-tile-media {
        width: 120px;
        flex-basis: 120px;
        padding-left: 0.5rem;
      }
      .home-news-tile-img { height: 72px; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .home-news-tile,
      .home-search-input-group {
        transition: none;
      }
    }
    main { min-height: 60vh; flex: 1; }

    .not-found-code {
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      color: var(--lycos-accent);
    }
    .not-found-path {
      font-size: 0.9em;
      background: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.08);
      color: #1a1d21;
      word-break: break-all;
    }

    .search-side-news { position: sticky; top: 1rem; }
    .search-side-news-title { color: var(--lycos-accent); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }
    .search-side-news-title:hover { text-decoration: underline !important; color: #0052a3; }
    .search-side-news-thumb { max-height: 120px; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

    .search-empty { max-width: 36rem; }
    .search-empty-form { max-width: 36rem; }
    .search-empty-input-group {
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(24, 28, 26, 0.18);
    }
    .search-empty-input-group:focus-within {
      border-color: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.55);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.15);
    }

    .shopping-ad-tag {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #b07d3a;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .shopping-amazon-btn .shopping-ad-tag {
      color: rgba(92, 52, 8, 0.55);
    }
    .shopping-cat-nav {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .shopping-cat-pill {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(24, 28, 26, 0.14);
      background: #fff;
      color: #3a3f3d;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      text-decoration: none;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .shopping-cat-pill:hover {
      border-color: rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.35);
      color: var(--lycos-accent);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .shopping-cat-pill.active {
      background: var(--lycos-dark-bg);
      border-color: var(--lycos-dark-bg);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .shopping-product {
      border: 1px solid rgba(24, 28, 26, 0.1);
      border-radius: 0.65rem;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .shopping-product-media {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 11rem;
      background: #f3f4f6;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .shopping-product-img {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 11rem;
      height: auto;
      max-height: 11rem;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
    }
    .shopping-product-title { color: var(--lycos-accent); }
    .shopping-product-title:hover { color: var(--lycos-accent-hover); text-decoration: underline !important; }
    .shopping-amazon-btn {
      background: #ff9900;
